obiter-dicta: Augustine Birrell's Obiter Dicta — things said by the way — gathers his witty literary essays. His talk of books and authors charmed Victorian readers. The perfect bedside book for book lovers. Lamb, Browning, and other favorites sparkle in his easy essays.
texas-a-brief-account-of-the-origin-prog: William Wharton gives a brief account of Texas — its origin, progress, and present state as a colonial settlement. Written to draw settlers, it is buoyant with promise. A foundational Texas document. Stephen Austin's colony and the fight for freedom fill his stirring pages.
the-naturalist-in-la-plata: W. H. Hudson's Naturalist in La Plata records Argentine birds, beasts, and pampas life with a poet's eye and a scientist's patience. His South American classic stands beside Darwin's own journal of the Beagle voyage. Wonderful natural history, beautifully written.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-grot: This article covers Grottaferrata, the Greek-rite abbey by Rome. St. Nilus founded it a thousand years ago. Douglas Raymund Webster honors its Eastern ways. East and West meet in its choir. Its monks still chant in Greek on feast days.
